in_hebrew.name: Falcone
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Strong, powerful falcon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Falcone הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Italian word for falcon, this name evokes images of strength, power, and agility. The falcon is a symbol of freedom and the ability to soar above challenges. In Christian tradition, the falcon represents the Holy Spirit descending upon the faithful.
